name: Summer Camp at Milford Point (Coastal Center Summer Camps)
description_short: A weekly nature day camp at Connecticut Audubon's Coastal Center in Milford for children who have completed grades K-5. Campers explore the beach, marsh, woodlands and gardens and do nature crafts, experiments and games, with a new theme each week.
refund_policy_summary: You can buy optional Registration Protection at checkout, which gives a full refund for specified reasons such as illness or injury. Without it, requests must be made by email at least two weeks before the session. Cancellations before June 1 are refunded minus a 20% fee per program, and membership fees are not refunded. There are no refunds after June 1. If the camp cancels a program, you get a full refund.
special_needs_notes: There is an Individual Plan of Care form for children who need medication or special care. Staff are trained in first aid, CPR and EpiPen use.
swim_waterfront_notes: Includes water habitat explorations, but no swimming.

warnings: This page is for the 2026 season (June 16 – August 15, 2026), which has already ended. No 2027 dates or prices are posted yet.
The dates look wrong for 2026: June 16, 2026 is a Tuesday and August 15, 2026 is a Saturday. They match 2025's calendar (Monday to Friday), so they may have been carried over from last year.
You must have a Connecticut Audubon membership to register: 'Chickadee ($58 family) or higher-level membership'. This cost is on top of the camp fee.
Ages are set by the grade your child has completed (K-1, 2-3, 4-5), not by age or the grade they are entering.
